## New scanner-first bench — partial local policy evidence
src/screens/LabBench.tsx plus lab-bench-policy.ts implement actual worklist/scan, patient identity, separate collect/receive/result, numeric/text grid, rejection/re-run/published amendment and tube labels. Original actor/sample/item/patient/state/schema are rechecked before writes. Numeric preview uses this patient reference_range and configured critical limits; text in critical.values is C. No inferred normal measurement. Identity permits real band or asked two identifiers; EmergencyOverride needs explicit unidentifiable-emergency statement plus factual note. A mismatching band stops collect/receive. Technician rendering and recovery whitelist clinical fields and never expose invoice/price objects or a payment action.
